claim_language.BEHAVIORAL: Circuit equations are physically meaningful but critical blocks are abstracted.
claim_language.MIXED-LEVEL: Some real/device-level physical components are integrated with behavioral blocks.
claim_language.PDK-LEVEL: Critical components use a real documented PDK.
claim_language.TRANSISTOR-LEVEL: Critical active circuitry is represented by transistor devices.
claim_language.HARDWARE: Physical fabricated/electronic hardware was actually measured.

primitives.circuit_topology: Architecture A: signed routing via unity inverters into one inverting TIA summing node per neuron. G = G_SCALE*|w|, Rf = 1/G_SCALE. Positive w uses inverted source; negative w uses the original source so V_tia = z.
primitives.component_mapping: one discrete resistor per nonzero weight/bias; shared input/reference inverters; one TIA per neuron
primitives.accuracy_limits: Isolated OPA189 o2 leftover ~0.7 mV at |z|~2.46 V; XOR |z|<1 V is the first compiler target.
primitives.technology_requirements: discrete resistors + documented precision op-amp TIA
primitives.validation_status: MIXED-LEVEL for OPA189 TIA host (Exp45-47, 58-61). Discrete-R XOR compile is Experiment 63.

primitives.circuit_topology: OPA189 IN+=0, IN-=sum, Rf from OUT to IN-
primitives.accuracy_limits: Level-1 macromodel. Isolated o2 W=10 8s8p |err|<=0.72 mV at -40/27/85 C.
primitives.validation_status: MIXED-LEVEL macromodel host. PHYSICAL TIA VALIDATED = NO (not MOS, not silicon). Unre-sized SKY130 Miller family CLOSED.

primitives.accuracy_limits: Level-1 macromodel invert used for sign routing
primitives.validation_status: MIXED-LEVEL. Experiment 33 documented invert family; used here as a sign primitive.

primitives.mathematical_function: y = max(-vin, 0); hidden TIA supplies vin=-z so y=max(z,0)
primitives.circuit_topology: textbook two-diode inverting precision rectifier: R1 from vin to IN-; Dclamp IN-->amp; Dfwd amp->y; Rf y to IN-; IN+=0
primitives.accuracy_limits: Experiment 62 gate: |y-max(0,z)| <= 1 mV on isolated sweep including frozen XOR hidden pre-activations
primitives.technology_requirements: TI OPAx189.LIB + 1N4148 extracted from TI TLC555.LIB
primitives.validation_status: DEMONSTRATED isolated (Experiment 62). MIXED-LEVEL. Not silicon. XOR-network insertion is Experiment 63.

primitives.mathematical_function: add constant b via 1 V reference conductance
primitives.circuit_topology: Vref=1 V; sign via vref or inverted vref per SignedDense_A
primitives.component_mapping: 1x 1 V reference, 1x resistor per bias, shared invert
